benchmark: privatenumber/minification-benchmarks with Nift integrated CLI adapter

methodology.process: Each upstream benchmark run executes in a fresh Node process; Nift additionally spawns a fresh nift process and performs temporary-file I/O inside the measured adapter boundary.
methodology.validation: Upstream artifact integrity checks before and after minification.

limitations: tedivm/jshrink was not run because PHP and Composer were unavailable; stale upstream repository results for it are excluded from this snapshot.
google-closure-compiler failed because Java was unavailable; failures are retained.
Nift is an integrated CLI result, not an in-process Minify++ engine result.

equivalence_probe.result: Standalone Minify++ and Nift outputs were byte-identical.
